answer: We formulate a protocol where dynamic staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay functions anchor identity creation to strict opportunity costs. When an adversary deploys identity multiplication across an ocean of virtual nodes, a subgame-perfect slashing matrix enforces immediate capital destruction, driving expected attack utility strictly below zero. This insurmountable barrier constrains the payoff space like a dense walnut shell, guaranteeing that honest validation is the unique robust Nash equilibrium in multi-agent environments.
